text:
Sylvia M: Quick async — capacity/balance handoff for tonight (short).
Sylvia M: What I did: drained 3 nodes in eu-west-1 (batch lane), validated node reattach, primed prefix cache on canary lanes. Ran the prewarm job for the new q4 model (no errors).
Sylvia M: Blockers: one AZ reporting quota throttle when spinning spot fallback (seen ~5% failed allocations). Filed ticket INF-4286 with cloud team — looks like an account-level rate limit on instance creation.
Sylvia M: Today / ask: can someone confirm quota bump request status for eu-west-1 (GPUs)? Also need a quick review on the canary routing tweak (small yaml) before I roll to prod.
Kevin R: ack on INF-4286, I pinged GCP support earlier, they said request id 0X-9891 is in review. Expect reply ~2-4h.
Kevin R: I can take the yaml review now — paste the snippet?
Sylvia M: pasted snippet in thread (config):
```
routes:
  - name: canary-gpu
    weight: 5
    regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
    model_fallback: small-quantized
```
Sylvia M: goal is tiny traffic to verify kernel selection on the newer card.
Jordan P: Quick note — if GCP denies the bump we should be ready to shift some prewarm jobs to us-west-2 for the next 6h window. I updated the runbook with the switchover steps (link: https://redwood/intern/runbooks/prewarm-switchover).
Kai L: On the quota side, finance approved a provisional spend increase yesterday, so we should be fine from a billing cap POV. Ops-bot: ran a quota-check at 1749995680 and reported: eu-west-1 GPU quota usage 92% of soft-limit, hard-limit = 120, current reserved = 110.
ops-bot: [automated] alert: spot fallback rate = 4.8% over last 30m, threshold = 3.0% :warning:
Kevin R: I'll take the canary roll after a quick lgtm from Jordan. If quota still blocked, I'll move 2 of the batch jobs to us-west-2 as a fallback.
Jordan P: lgtm on yaml. Minor nit: add `max_retries: 1` to reduce cascading queuing on failure.
Sylvia M: added `max_retries: 1`. Thanks.
Kai L: I'll keep an eye on Infra dashboard — will update here if GCP responds.
Kevin R: taking action: will try rolling canary at 1749995745, will post results (latency + error rates)
Sylvia M: thanks team. If anyone wants to pair on the INF-4286 support thread ping me — I'll be around for the next hour. :thumbsup: 
Jordan P: noted. heading offline after this ping, leave any follow-ups here.
ops-bot: [automated status] canary roll triggered at 1749995745, canary traffic stable, 99.6% success over 5m.
Sylvia M: closing handoff — if quota bump lands, we'll scale reserve to 120; otherwise fallback plan as above. Cheers.
